bash: # Verify role_count matches source
echo "=== role_count verification ==="
jq '.[0] as $first | $first.user_id as $uid | {user_id: $uid, role_count: $first.role_count, actual_count: ([.[] | select(.id == $uid) | .roles | length] | .[0])}' /app/active_users_report.json /app/users.json

# Verify primary_role matches first role in source
echo "=== primary_role verification ==="
jq '.[0] as $first | $first.user_id as $uid | {user_id: $uid, primary_role: $first.primary_role, actual_first: ([.[] | select(.id == $uid) | .roles[0]] | .[0])}' /app/active_users_report.json /app/users.json

# Verify all role_counts match
echo "=== All role_counts match ==="
jq -r '.[].user_id' /app/active_users_report.json | while read uid; do
  rc=$(jq --argjson id "$uid" '.[] | select(.id == $id) | .roles | length' /app/users.json)
  actual=$(jq --argjson id "$uid" --argjson rc "$rc" '.[] | select(.user_id == $id) | .role_count' /app/active_users_report.json)
  if [ "$rc" != "$actual" ]; then
    echo "MISMATCH: user_id $uid role_count=$rc but output=$actual"

done
echo "All role_counts verified"

  if [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then
